assessments.reasoning: The guide describes the customizable platform separately from the programming language used in modules. Its Russian counterpart confirms the native programming-language referent within the broader platform. The OneScript project identifies its separate virtual machine.
The Russian publisher page identifies the built-in language as one mechanism of 1C:Enterprise 8 for application business logic. It is a version-family description of the language referent.

The OneScript project describes an independently implemented execution environment for related source. This context supports the boundary between 1C as the documented language and OneScript as a separate implementation, without proving exact compatibility.

limitations: Product configuration metadata, query text, Designer interfaces and independent execution environments have distinct scopes.
